body:
The 404 is GitHub Pages still off for this repo (the Pages API returns 404, so GitHub is not serving `gh-pages` yet). The review files are on the `gh-pages` branch under `pr/67/`.

Enable it once: Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → `gh-pages` / `/`. After that, https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/67/ should load. I cannot flip that setting from here.

Posted by Cursor Grok 4.6 [cursor-grok-4.6]
